name: Greymane Wall
summary: At Silverpine’s southern edge, Greymane Wall bars the way into Gilneas. King Genn Greymane raised the stone barrier after the Second War, and its gates remain locked against the outside world.

sections.title: A Monument to Isolation
sections.body: King Genn Greymane turned from the Alliance after the Second War, resentful of its demands, especially the taxes for the orc internment camps. He believed Gilneas had paid enough in coin and blood for troubles beyond its borders. Greymane withdrew the kingdom from the Alliance and ordered a vast barrier built across the head of the peninsula. When the Third War brought the Plague of Undeath and desperate refugees to the wall, its gates stayed shut.

sections.title: The Price of Seclusion
sections.body: The wall kept the Scourge from overrunning the peninsula, but Silverpine beyond it found no such safety. Archmage Arugal of Dalaran summoned feral worgen to fight the undead. The beasts could not be controlled, and now prowl the forest beneath the silent wall. What lies behind the gates remains unknown to the outside world.

faq.q: What lies beyond the Greymane Wall?
aliases: what kingdom is behind the wall
faq.answer: The peninsula kingdom of Gilneas lies beyond the wall, ruled by King Genn Greymane. Before the Third War, Gilneas cut itself off from Lordaeron and the rest of the world, closing all commerce and communication.

faq.q: Can you open the gates of the Greymane Wall?
aliases: how to get past greymane wall
faq.answer: No. The portcullis and iron-banded doors are barred from the southern side. Gilneas has severed all contact with the outside world, and nothing enters or leaves.

faq.q: Why was the wall built here instead of farther south?
aliases: why did they build it here
faq.answer: No record explains the wall’s exact course. It crosses Silverpine’s southern edge at the head of the Gilnean peninsula, leaving villages such as Pyrewood and Ambermill to its north.

faq.q: What happened to the refugees who fled here during the Third War?
faq.answer: When the Scourge ravaged Lordaeron, crowds of human refugees gathered outside the wall and begged to enter. King Greymane refused to open the gates to protect his kingdom, and the undead eventually slaughtered the desperate refugees outside.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Greymane Wall recalls Gilneas’s abandonment of its former allies. When the Scourge took Lordaeron, Greymane ignored their pleas and left them outside his gates.
For the Forsaken, who now claim Silverpine Forest, Greymane Wall marks an impassable southern border. It seals away a human kingdom whose intentions and strength remain unknown.
